title: C: verify existing real AI provider and workflow gates
public_pr_body:
The existing Anthropic SDK adapter is real, not null/placeholder: default provider selection invokes it; deployed mock selection deliberately returns null. Existing panels/routes, reservation-before-key/provider, validation/settlement, company switches, request logging and safe credential messages reviewed without rebuilding.

190 focused tests passed, 0 failed/skipped across seven existing suites, all mocked SDK/DB dependencies. No live AI call, keys, SQL or activation. RLS source is identified; final-sha database/browser/model acceptance and production configuration remain unproven. Existing provided-mode 1000p #387 and legacy own-key 500p are explicitly distinguished. Production must stay OFF until authorised.

Docs/test evidence only. No merge, private files, #359/go-live edits or John messages.
